disposition_reason: Prints site means for iron, copper and lead in cow and buffalo milk, cheese and cream from three Basrah regions; nickel and cadmium were not detected.

study.design: Market and local sampling survey of cow and buffalo milk, cheese and cream
study.origin: Cow and buffalo dairy from three areas of Basrah city, southern Iraq
study.market: Local areas: Basrah centre, Abu Al-Khaseeb, Al-Zubair
study.method: Oven drying 60 °C, HNO3/HClO4 digestion, flame AAS (Phoenix-986)
study.qa: Working standards only; no CRM, blanks or recovery reported
